notes.subject: ומעוננים
notes.rationale: root ענן: 'observers of clouds' (diviners by omens) vs 'soothsayers' — mi givim piksa bilong skelim sta.

notes.subject: כשפים
notes.gloss: magic rendered 'pasin bilong puripuri' — Tok Pisin i no gat wanpela tok, hyphen picture klostu long Hebrew.

translation: Na bai mi katim ol pasin bilong puripuri i go ausait long han bilong yu, na ol man i save skelim ol sta o no gat man i save tok olsem, bai ol i no moa stap long yu.

tokens.gloss: i go ausait long han bilong yu
na ol man i save skelim ol sta
